entities.name: Ralph Graf von Oriola

entities.summary: Ralph Graf von Oriola was a German general in the Wehrmacht during World War II who commanded the XIII. Armeekorps. He was a recipient of the Knight's Cross of the Iron Cross of Nazi Germany.
